       Pursuant to 16 Texas Administrative Code (TAC) § 22.144, Intervenor The Thomas F. Green

and Heidi A. Green Living Trust (“Intervenor” or “the Trust”) requests that Applicant Oncor Electric

Delivery Company (“Applicant”) provide responses to the following Requests for Information

(“RFI”) served in response to Applicants’ Rebuttal Testimony involving Thomas F. Green and the

Trust. Intervenors request that Applicant answer the questions in the order in which they are listed

with sufficient detail to provide a complete and accurate answer to each within ten business days of

these requests.

                                       INSTRUCTIONS


 1. Pursuant to rules 22.141 through 22.144 of title 16 of the Texas Administrative Code, you
    are hereby requested to respond to and adhere to Tom Green’s first Request for
    Information.

 2. Specifically, pursuant to 16 TAC § 22.144(c)(2)(F), you are requested to answer the requests
    for information under oath.

 3. If any request cannot be answered in full, you are to answer to the extent and in the manner
    possible, using an estimate if exact figures or detailed records are not available, and specify
    that an estimate rather than an exact figure or statement has been used.

 4. If you claim that any documents are lost or destroyed, identify and describe each document
    by date, author, and recipient, and provide a summary of its contents and how and why it
    was destroyed.

 5. In any instance where you respond to a request by referring to a document in the record,
    please specify in detail the location of the document, including the docket, item, and page
    number.

 6. Should any request be responded with an assertion of privilege, you are to comply with the
    procedure as explained in rule 22.144(d)(2) of title 16 of the Texas Administrative Code and
    respond with documents or information where the privilege is not applicable.

 7. For documents where they are stored and presented only on computer software, you are to
    produce them in their native format.

 8. Should you find more documents or information after responding, you are to supplement
    your responses in a supplemental response document.

 9. If you have any questions concerning the instructions, definitions, or requests for
    information attached, please reach out to undersigned via e-mail.

 10. Unless otherwise specified, the Relevant Time Period for each of the below-stated RFIs is
     from the enactment of H.B. 5066 (May 2023) to present.




 INTERVENOR THE THOMAS F. GREEN AND HEIDI A. GREEN LIVING TRUST’S
   REQUESTS FOR INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO APPLICANTS’ REBUTTAL
TESTIMONY | PUC DOCKET NO. 59475; SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26-16349 | Page 3
                                         DEFINITIONS

 1. “You” and “Oncor” refers to Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC, and any persons,
    agents, employees, entities, and all other representation working on its behalf.

 2. “Application” shall mean Joint Application For Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC And
    LCRA Transmission Services Corporation To Amend Their Certificate Of Convenience
    And Necessity For The Bell County East Switch to Big Hill Substation 765-kV
    Transmission Line Project In Crane, Crockett, Irion, Pecos, Reagan, Reeves, Schleicher,
    Tom Green, Upton, And Ward Counties, SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349 and PUC
    Docket No. 59475.

 3. “PBRP” refers to the Permian Basin Reliability Plan approved by the Public Utility
    Commission of Texas.

 4. “ERCOT” refers to the Electric Reliability Council of Texas.

 5. “Transmission Line” or “Transmission Lines” refers to the 765-kV transmission lines as
    described by Oncor in their Proposed Transmission Line Project TG: and add “,
    including substations and SCADA are all related integral and peripheral materials and
    equipment to be a part of the proposed construction.

 6. “PURA” refers to the Public Utility Regulatory ACT of the Texas Utilities Code.

 7. “EMP hardened” means technologies or mitigation practices endorsed by experts for
    preventing adverse effects from an electromagnetic pulse.

 8. Fragmentation of the Landscape” refers to Oncor or its affiliated agents’ description as
    used by them in their “Fragmentation submitted documents concerning the PBRP.

 9. “Critical Path” refers to Oncor or its affiliated agents’ description as used by them in their
    submitted documents concerning the PBRP.

 10. “Environment Analysis” or “Environmental Analysis” refers to Oncor or its affiliated
     agents’ description as used by them in their submitted documents concerning the PBRP.

 11. “Natural Features” refers to how it is described by PURA. TG: Might have dodged this one as
     well.

 12. “Cultural Value” refers to how it is described by PURA.

  13. “Preferred Route” refers to Oncor and its affiliated agents’ description as used by them in
     their submitted documents concerning the PBRP.

 14. The term “documents” shall mean writings of every type and from any source, including
     originals and nonidentical copies thereof, that are in your possession, custody, or control or

 15. “Possession” of an item means that the person either has physical possession of the item or
     has a right to possession equal or superior to that of the person how has physical possession
     of the item.

 16. “Person” means any natural person, corporation, firm, association, partnership, joint
     venture, proprietorship, governmental body, or any other organization, business, or legal
     entity, and all predecessors or successors in interest.

 17. “Identify” or “describe” when referring to a person, means you must state the following:
             a. The full name.
             b. The present or last known residential address and residential telephone number.
             c. The present or last known office address and office telephone number.
             d. The occupation, job title, employer, and employer’s address at the time of the
     event or period referred to in each particular interrogatory.
             e. In the case of any entity, identify the officer, employee, or agent most closely
     connected with the subject matter of the request for information and the officer who is
     responsible for supervising that officer or employee.

 18. “Identify” or “describe” when referring to a document, means you must state the following:
         a. The nature (e.g., letter, handwritten note) of the document.
        b. The title or heading that appears on the document.
         c. The date of the document and the date of each addendum, supplement, or other
     addition or change.
         d. The identity of the author and of the signer of the document, and of the person on
     whose behalf or at whose request or direction the document was prepared or delivered.
         e. The present location of the document, and the name, address, position or title, and
     telephone number of the person or persons having custody of the document.

 19. The term “Communications” or “Communicated” means and refers to communication by
     any means, including but not limited to cellular telephone, text, email, online application (i.e.
     Facebook, WhatsApp, etc.), facsimile, letter or other writing, instant messaging, and any
     other electronic forms of communication.

 20. All other terms herein are to be given their regular dictionary meaning.

  I. REQUESTS FOR INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO APPLICANTS’ REBUTTAL
                           TESTIMONY

TG-1.           Please provide all documents reviewed, analyses prepared, and communications
        prepared in connection with or relied upon for development of the Final Analysis made the
        basis of the GCT’s in association with 59475.

TG-2.           Please explain, and provide evidentiary basis for, Applicants’ contention that the
        current power grid and lines throughout the Permian Basin are not “sufficient” as opined in
        the rebuttal testimony as to the Trust’s Direct Testimony.

TG-3.           Please provide explain, and provide evidentiary basis for, Applicants’ contention as
        to the allegedly necessitated electrical flow as proposed in Applicants’ Application in this
        proceeding.

TG-4.           In his rebuttal testimony, Collin Martin (“Mr. Martin”) testifies that ERCOT
        established the North-to-Far West (N-FW) and South-to-Far West (S-FW) Generic
        Transmission Constraints in September 2025. The CCN applications in this proceeding were
        filed substantially earlier. Please provide:

        (a) the date on which the CCN application that is the subject of this proceeding was filed
        with the PUC;

        (b) the date on which ERCOT first identified the system conditions that led to the
        establishment of the Far West Import GTCs;

        (c) the date on which ERCOT first communicated to Oncor or LCRA TSC that the Far
        West Import GTCs would be established; and

        (d) all documents, analyses, and communications between ERCOT and the Applicants
        regarding the Far West Import GTCs from January 1, 2024 through the date of filing of the
        Martin Rebuttal.

TG-5.            Mr. Martin’s testimony addresses the need for Import Path 2 as a whole, meaning
        both the Bell County East to Big Hill CCN that is the subject of this proceeding and the Big
        Hill to Sand Lake Switch CCN that is the subject of a separate docket. What portion of the
        reduction in Far West Import GTC exposure is attributable solely to the Bell County East to
        Big Hill segment that is the subject of this proceeding, as opposed to the full three-path 765-
        kV build-out?

TG-6.           Please explain whether Mr. Martin contends that the existence of the Far West
        Import GTCs, which were established in September 2025 (after the CCN application was
        filed and after much of the PBRP planning was completed) invalidates or is inconsistent
        with any argument made by Tom Green in his direct testimony.
